features: Explosion-proof (316L stainless steel, ATEX/IECEx/NEMA 4X) thermal and optical bi-spectrum bullet camera
Thermal: uncooled VOx 256x192 detector, 12 um pixel pitch, NETD < 40 mK, 7 mm F1.0 lens, 24.9 x 18.7 field of view
Optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 1/2.7in CMOS, 4 mm lens, 84 x 44.8 field of view, 120 dB WDR
Temperature measurement -20 to 550 C, accuracy Max (+/-2 C, +/-2 %); 21 rules (10 points, 10 regions, 1 line)
IR supplement up to 30 m on the optical channel
Perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
Audio in/out, 2 alarm in / 2 alarm out

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical (Channel 1) and thermal (Channel 2) exposed as separate channels.

release_notes: Explosion-proof thermal and optical bi-spectrum bullet camera pairing a 256x192 uncooled VOx detector (12 um, NETD < 40 mK, 7 mm lens) with a 4 MP optical channel, temperature measurement -20 to 550 C and 30 m IR. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.
